id: title:jurajmajerik:note that surveys on a draft experiment wait for launch

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the UX of the Experiment Feedback tab by warning users that surveys will not receive responses until the experiment launches, rather than showing an empty state or no banner. This could help prevent user confusion when viewing an experiment that exists but hasn't started.
review.reason: Adds a conditional info banner and wraps the FeedbackTabContent in a fragment; the banner displays when an experiment has no start_date and its feature flag is not active. This is a narrow, localized UX improvement.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that this warning prevents user confusion, which is not independently verified by the code or release notes. No broader systemic changes or critical path dependencies are demonstrated.

observations.limitations: Only P1.F1.H1 is supplied. No score assigned.
